user.title: Solar Battery Manager — Entities
user.description: Select the sensors used in read-only simulation mode. No inverter settings will be modified.

data.load_energy_entity: House load energy sensor (for daytime history)

data_description.grid_charge_current_entity: Inverter entity with the max grid charging current in Amperes (e.g. number.inversordeye_battery_grid_charging_current).
data_description.sun_entity: Optional Sun integration entity (sun.sun) to automatically derive sunrise and sunset hours.

parameters.title: Battery & Schedule Parameters
parameters.description: Configure usable battery capacity (do not assume nominal 15 kWh), estimation window, and tariff schedule.

error.invalid_entity: Selected entity was not found or is invalid.
error.invalid_sun_entity: Selected Sun entity does not exist or lacks sunrise/sunset attributes (next_rising, next_setting).
error.invalid_parameters: One or more battery or schedule parameters are out of range.

abort.already_configured: Solar Battery Manager is already configured.

init.title: Solar Battery Manager — Options
init.description: Adjust calculation parameters. Integration runs in read-only simulation mode.

data.load_energy_entity: House load energy sensor (for daytime history)

data_description.grid_charge_current_entity: Inverter entity with the max grid charging current in Amperes (e.g. number.inversordeye_battery_grid_charging_current).
data_description.sun_entity: Sun integration entity (sun.sun) used to obtain sunrise and sunset times.

error.invalid_sun_entity: Selected Sun entity does not exist or lacks sunrise/sunset attributes (next_rising, next_setting).
